decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal, by reason of the height, design, materials and visually dominant appearance of the front boundary treatment, would fail to respect the established character and appearance of the area and would appear as an incongruous feature within the street scene. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies CC1, CC2 and SC7 of the Hounslow Local Plan and the Residential Extensions Guidelines

Reason : 2 - The proposal, by reason of the use of non-permeable materials, the complete loss of the front garden and soft landscaping, the lack of biodiversity enhancements, the creation of an excessive expanse of hardstanding, and the absence of sufficient details demonstrating that surface water runoff would be adequately managed, would result in an unsympathetic form of development that harms the character and appearance of the area. Furthermore, the proposal has failed to demonstrate that appropriate drainage measures would be provided to justify the complete loss of the front garden to hardstanding. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies CC1, CC2, SC7 and GB7 of the Local Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Reason : 3 - The proposal has failed to demonstrate that the use of the front garden for off-street parking would comply with the Council's adopted Residential Crossovers and Off-Street Parking Policy. The development would not provide a separate pedestrian access or a clear 1.2m-wide route to the front door, and insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that vehicles could safely enter and exit the site in a single manoeuvre. Furthermore, the excessive height of the proposed front gates and railings would harm visibility and pedestrian, cyclist and highway safety. The proposal would therefore result in an unacceptable and unsafe parking arrangement, contrary to Policy EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan, the Residential Extension Guidelines and the Residential Crossovers and Off-Street Parking Policy (2016).
description: Revised single storey side infill extension, installation of drainage channel adjacent to the front boundary, and reduction in height of front gate and piers.
